title: Key Reps
pitch: A tiny terminal game for learning Unix and Readline keyboard shortcuts.
description: Each drill hands you a broken command line and counts the key presses you take to fix it: perfect in green, close in yellow, detours in red. Lessons build from single shortcuts to multi-step repairs, on a simulated shell.

externals.name: Browser-reserved shortcuts
externals.seam: The browser handles a few keys before the page sees them
externals.note: Your browser keeps a few shortcuts for itself, such as Ctrl+W and Ctrl+T, so drills that need them work best in your own terminal.
